symptoms_en: Silvery streaks or white patches on leaves, leaf tips dry in bad attacks; flowers and buds drop; some spread tomato spotted wilt virus.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियों पर चाँदी जैसी धारियाँ या सफ़ेद धब्बे, ज़्यादा प्रकोप में सिरे सूखते हैं; फूल और कलियाँ झड़ती हैं; कुछ थ्रिप्स टमाटर स्पॉटेड विल्ट विषाणु फैलाते हैं।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of tomato
symptoms_en.quote: Silvery streaks on leaf surface Pre-mature dropping of flowers Bud necrosis. Vector of tomato spotted wilt virus.

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of onion
symptoms_en.quote: Small white silvery patches are seen all over the leaves

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of tomato
management_en.quote: Mechanically uproot the diseased plants and destroy them Use yellow sticky traps @ 15/ha

management_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of onion
management_en.quote: Clean cultivation, regular hoeing Flooding of infested field will check the thrips population.

recipe_slugs.title: NITI Aayog: Empowering Farmers, Natural Farming Training Toolkit and Best Practices Guide
recipe_slugs.quote: For sucking pests (like thrips and whitefly) in the early stage: Spray Neemastra @ 200 litres per acre
recipe_slugs.note: Natural-farming guide (NITI); the recipe is matched to the pest class, not tested on this crop in Malwa.

management_en: Use yellow sticky traps (15 per hectare). Uproot and destroy diseased plants. In onion keep the field clean and hoe regularly; flooding the field checks thrips.
management_hi: पीले चिपचिपे ट्रैप लगाएँ (15 प्रति हेक्टेयर)। रोगी पौधे उखाड़कर नष्ट करें। प्याज़ में खेत साफ़ रखें और नियमित गुड़ाई करें; खेत में पानी भरने से थ्रिप्स कम होते हैं।
